d:
Here are some thoughts and observations on making friends! Being useful helps bring more people around you, but are these "real" friends we make? Well, it depends on how you see it. In this video, I offer 2 perspectives: a more cynical take and a more benevolent one.
Either way, it is my opinion and preference to try to help others when possible. They may not always stay around as friends, but it's a good way to connect with others. Many of us are rightfully reserved and cautious around others - it can be good to give someone a reason to trust us (as long as we continue to uphold that).
